title: 第23章 古卷进阶戮妖大祭第24章 邻居消息圣宝楼
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 【退休福报古卷：零阶（9651000）】
【享受福报：零阶每日享受生活可获得福报点5】
【健康福报：零阶每日运动，可获得福报点5】
【专属福报：15】
一天福报加专属福报能获得三十点，进度增长非常快，只差最后三十五点。
没有犹豫，沈云熟练的拿起墨钎和源石，赚钱第一位。
神情专注的在源石上篆刻起了玄妙的符号。
随着符师进度的不断提升，从一开始的五十点福报加持必成符石，降成了四十点必成。
这个发现令沈云又惊又喜。
十五日前那五个源石，早就全部制作成护体符石。
售出后买了十枚源石，一本《敛息诀》，剩余的一百金给了婉儿。
家里每日伙食费提高到了两金的程度，基本普通灵米，蛮兽肉，灵果不间断。
十枚源石已经制作出了四枚护体符石，沈云现在做的是第五枚。
待到十枚全部做完卖出，家里的小金库足够到千金了。
到时候去城内正规修行店铺长长见识，修行者增幅气血的宝器，虚空袋，血食丹药，功法典籍应有尽有。
制作完符石，沈云迅速打开古卷.
已然发生了变化。
【退休福报古卷：一阶（55000）】
【享受福报：一阶每日享受生活可获得福报点10】
【健康福报：一阶每日运动，可获得福报点10】
看到一阶进度后面是五千，沈云松了口气。
他真怕翻十倍啊！
“每日福报点获取也翻倍了！”
原本一天十点，现在成了二十点。
这是好事，福报点再多都不够用。
想到了什么，沈云连忙翻过来古卷看向伴侣那一栏。
【绑定伴侣（壹）：每日与退休伴侣友好交流】
【专属奖励：根据伴侣亲密度，每日交流情感可获得伴侣专属福报点（亲密度一成）】
【加成奖励：根据伴侣满意度，对每日福报点结算加成】
【苏婉儿】
【宿主满意度98%】
这个没有变化，不过得益于基础值翻倍，沈云每日福报点上限到了五十点。
一天一枚符石没问题了。
“可惜没增加伴侣名额！”
沈云看着伴侣后面的（壹）没变化，有些失望。
如果他没猜错，多一个伴侣加成，获得的福报点肯定会更多。
可以考虑提前物色女修，以免到时匆忙不好寻找合适绑定对象。
content_en:
[Ancient Retirement Blessings Scroll: Level 0 (9651000)]
[Enjoy blessings: Enjoying life every day at level 0 can earn 5 blessing points]
[Health Blessing: Level 0 Daily Exercise, You Can Get 5 Blessing Points]
[Technical hobbies: Humanity Talisman Master (apprentice 6011000), Purple Thunder Breathing Technique (module 3031000), Rolling Stone Technique (module 451000), Breath Condensation Technique (module 1351000), Qi and Blood Silk Condensation Technique (Daecheng 25510000), Sculpture (Dacheng 35610000), Health Preserving Boxing (Xiaocheng 2251000)...]
【Fortunate points: 65】
[Exclusive blessing: 15]
Thirty points can be obtained by adding the exclusive blessings in one day, and the progress is increasing very quickly, leaving only the last thirty-five points.
Without hesitation, Shen Yun skillfully picked up the ink hammer and source stone, taking the first place in making money.
[Humanity Talisman Master (Apprentice 6011000)] +40
With a focused expression, he carved mysterious symbols on the Origin Stone.
As the progress of the Talisman Master continues to improve, from the initial fifty points of blessing blessing, the rune stones must be turned into, and it has been reduced to forty points.
This discovery surprised and delighted Shen Yun.
The five Origin Stones fifteen days ago had all been made into protective talisman stones.
After the sale, I bought ten Origin Stones, a copy of "The Secret of Breath Condensation", and gave the remaining one hundred gold to Wan'er.
The family's daily food expenses have been increased to two gold, which is basically ordinary spiritual rice, beast meat, and spiritual fruits.
Ten source stones have been used to produce four protective talisman stones, and Shen Yun is currently making the fifth one.
When all ten pieces are finished and sold, the family's small treasury will be enough to reach a thousand gold pieces.
When the time comes, go to a regular practice shop in the city to learn more. There are all kinds of treasures for practitioners to increase Qi and blood, such as void bags, blood-eating elixirs, and Kung Fu books.
After making the rune stones, Shen Yun quickly opened the ancient scroll.
Things have changed.
[Ancient Scroll of Retirement Blessings: Level 1 (55000)]
[Enjoy blessings: You can get 10 blessing points by enjoying life every day at the first level]
[Health Blessing: Daily exercise at the first level can obtain 10 blessing points]
Seeing that the first level of progress was followed by five thousand, Shen Yun breathed a sigh of relief.
He was really afraid of it getting doubled!
“The daily blessing points earned have also been doubled!”
It used to be ten o'clock a day, but now it's twenty o'clock.
This is a good thing, no amount of blessings is enough.
Thinking of something, Chen Yun quickly turned over the ancient scroll and looked at the partner column.
[Binding partners (1): Friendly communication with retired partners every day]
[Exclusive reward: Based on your partner's intimacy, you can get your partner's exclusive blessing points by communicating with each other every day (10% intimacy)]
[Bonus reward: Based on your partner’s satisfaction, a bonus will be added to the settlement of daily blessing points]
【Su Waner】
[Intimacy: 99]
[Host satisfaction 98%]
This has not changed, but thanks to the doubling of the base value, the upper limit of Shen Yun's daily blessing points has reached fifty points.
One rune stone a day is no problem.
"It's a pity that the number of partners has not been increased!"
Shen Yun was a little disappointed when he saw that (1) behind his partner had not changed.
If he guessed correctly, with the bonus of having one more partner, he would definitely get more blessing points.
You can consider identifying female cultivators in advance to avoid being in a hurry to find a suitable binding partner.
